question: Which cache theory did the incident channel abandon, and may an engineer who is not in that channel inspect its old discussion?

claims.text:
[SYNTHETIC]
Partner users may read approved integration eligibility guidance; incident details are not public guidance.

[SYNTHETIC]
The old 17:00 deadline applies only to the retired September pilot, not current weekday batches.

[SYNTHETIC]
The webhook backlog came from an exhausted worker pool, not DNS resolution.
Runbook v1: inspect the payment-service timeout budget and follow the approved failover procedure.

[SYNTHETIC]
Beginning 2026-11-01, service tokens expire after thirty minutes; before that date they expire after sixty minutes.

[SYNTHETIC]
Partner-led onboarding requires manual verification; direct onboarding supports automated verification.
PAY-101 tracks the payment-service incident. See the final postmortem and the current runbook.

[SYNTHETIC]
Removal from a source channel prevents future citation and history access; previously saved copies cannot be recalled.

[SYNTHETIC]
The proposed November hourly schedule is not approved. Current settlement is daily.
PAY-102 code fix: Done. Code completion does not approve general customer release.

[SYNTHETIC]
An unsigned draft says MYR settlement is available; it is a proposal, not the approved operating rule.

[SYNTHETIC]
The Atlas connector supports Singapore business SGD accounts, not personal accounts.

Atlas account eligibility
Account	Scope

 Singapore business SGD 	 Pilot supported 

 Personal SGD 	 Not supported

[SYNTHETIC]
When current source access cannot be verified, do not treat a prior allow decision as current permission.
Release decision: controlled pilot approved. General availability (GA) not approved. PAY-102 Done is not customer release approval.
Payment-retry is available only to the controlled pilot. General availability (GA) is not approved. No general release date is confirmed.
Final root cause: retry configuration mismatched the timeout budget, causing a backlog of duplicate requests. Confirmed at 10:00 +08:00. Follow-ups: PAY-102 and PAY-103.
